ios.desc:
Meşk Tune is a World Music tuning app!
The ultimate tuner for bağlama, oud, tanbur, banjo, violin, kemane, guitar, ukulele and all popular string instruments around the globe. 
Unique graphical interface, 
Easy to use and accurate

World Music Tuner
Standart Chromatic Tuner 
Microtonal Tuner: Eastern and Western Temperaments are included. (Turkish Makam Music, Persian and Arabic Sound Systems, Baroque Period Temperaments
Historical Tuning Presets 

Bağlama Tuner:
Specific Tuning feature for bağlama. It is perfect for complete beginner bağlama players. Bağlama Tuning Feature allows you to learn the strings and tune them one by one.
Recommended by bağlama teachers.

Historical Tuner:
Professional accuracy for advanced players.
Tuning presents were analyzed and collected according to the master's original performances. For instance, you can fine-tune your instrument into Aşık Veysel's scale. You are ready to play with the master's original tunes.


Meşk Tune works with:

Bağlama,
Cura,
Oud,
Tanbur,
Kanun
Electric and acoustic guitars
Bass
Mandolin
Ukulele
Viola
Violin
Cello
Fiddle
Balalaika
Banjo
Many other string instruments

Designed by the passion for all music enthusiasts
 
Please be careful: If it is your first time tuning your instrument, We recommend watching our tuning tutorials on youtube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLJdfxKoiKCbMkBp6_XME-O0A-pKT2qOyc

Send us feedback:
Got ideas to make Meşk Tune even better? Send your ideas and suggestions to: feedback@meskteknoloji.com
